LanguageData.VV_Quest_EndingMissiveGoals: Contact the vivi federation via comms console and complete a task to earn an ancient amber core. Use it to build the everflower altar, enshrine a level 4 everflower at its center, and perform the grand attunement to begin the fifth bloom. \nYou cannot request another task while an ancient amber core or an altar built with one still exists.
LanguageData.VV_Quest_EndingDesc: The everflower on the altar has entered its fifth bloom and is condensing mana for its final bloom. \nDefend the altar until condensation is complete. The resonator can then perform the queen's coronation to complete the final bloom. \nIf the everflower on the altar is lost, the quest fails.
LanguageData.VV_Letter_EndingFederationMissive:
The everflower resonating with {PAWN_labelShort} has reached its limit. It cannot condense any more mana on ordinary soil. 
The vivi federation's representative has sensed these waves and sent a message. 
"It has been a long time since we saw an everflower grow this far. The great everflowers of the old empire are said to have bloomed on altars carved with ancient mana circuits. But once the fifth bloom begins, its waves will draw outlanders and titanic hornet swarms to you." 
You can now build the everflower altar. To obtain its ancient amber core, contact the vivi federation via comms console and complete a task for them.
LanguageData.VV_Quest_EndingMissiveStepEnshrine: Enshrine an everflower of attunement level {0} at the center of the altar
LanguageData.VV_Letter_EverflowerEcho1:
After the ritual, faint static entered {PAWN_labelShort}'s psychic circuits. 
A golden flower with six branches bloomed on a vast altar. The vivis living in its shade knew neither unstable genes nor short lives. 
"...Beneath this shade... no one withers..." 
The whisper faded into static. {PAWN_labelShort} seemed to have glimpsed an old memory within the everflower.
LanguageData.VV_Letter_EverflowerEcho2Label: Memory of a scorched blossom wind
LanguageData.VV_Letter_EverflowerEcho2:
As the ritual ended, a sharp ringing filled {PAWN_labelShort}'s head. 
The smell of rot spread through a hive in bloom. Vivis lost their minds and tore at one another's wings. Neither herbs nor magic could heal their blackened wounds. The hives were burning. 
"...It's in the wind... mixed in..." "...Before the altar... only I remain..." 
{PAWN_labelShort} came to in a cold sweat. The everflower's petals were trembling.
LanguageData.VV_Letter_EverflowerEcho3:
While resonating with the everflower, {PAWN_labelShort} was caught in an unfamiliar memory. 
Someone was opening their circuits to the limit. Across the burning land, dying vivis turned into small lights and gathered endlessly within a single soul. 
"...If I do not die... they will not die..." "...All of you... into me... not a single one..." 
As the lights multiplied, it grew harder to breathe. Even after the memory faded, {PAWN_labelShort} could not get up for a while.
LanguageData.VV_Letter_EverflowerEcho4:
As {PAWN_labelShort} finished the ritual, a broken voice came through with a surge of pain. 
"...So heavy... too..." 
Overloaded circuits collapsed. A body grew a hard shell and enormous mandibles. Wings emerged from its back. The voice grew harder to understand. 
"...Who was I... the children..." 
A vast shadow surrounded by small lights sank into the ruins. Then there was silence.
LanguageData.VV_Letter_EverflowerEcho5Label: A breath seeking the flower's shade
LanguageData.VV_Letter_EverflowerEcho5:
As mana waves spread from the everflower, static returned to {PAWN_labelShort}'s psychic circuits. This time it was no memory. 
Hard shells clattered together. There was a sound of labored breathing. Something was following the mana back toward {PAWN_labelShort}. 
"...So warm..." "...Back... to the flower's shade..." 
The connection broke. Something sleeping in the ruins had sensed the everflower's waves and awakened.
LanguageData.VV_Comms_AmberCoreRequest: Request a task in exchange for an ancient amber core
LanguageData.VV_Comms_AmberCoreRequestActive: a task has already been given
LanguageData.VV_Comms_AmberCoreRequestCoreExists: an ancient amber core or altar already exists
LanguageData.VV_Comms_AmberCoreRequestConditions: the missive's conditions are not met: {0}
LanguageData.VV_Comms_AmberCoreRequestResult: {LEADER} has entrusted you with a task in exchange for a relic of the old empire. Once it is done, the vivi federation will send an ancient amber core.
LanguageData.VV_Comms_AmberCoreRequestNoQuest: {LEADER}: "We have no task to entrust to you right now. Contact us again later."
LanguageData.VV_Letter_EndingSiege: The everflower on the altar has entered its fifth bloom. The everflower resonates with the altar's mana circuits, sending mana waves across the planet. \nThe everflower will condense mana for about {DAYS} days. Enemies drawn by these waves are converging on the colony.
LanguageData.VV_Letter_EndingSiegeFederation: The vivi federation will send elite reinforcements from time to time.
LanguageData.VV_Letter_EndingFederationAid: The vivi federation has dispatched {COUNT} elite warriors to defend the everflower altar. They will stay for a while to fight alongside you before returning home.
LanguageData.VV_Letter_EndingCalm: The approaching enemies have suddenly vanished. Even the titanic hornet swarms have withdrawn. \nAn unknown psychic wave is interfering with the everflower's roots, halting bloom condensation. Through the resonance link, {PAWN_labelShort} can feel something approaching, surrounded by the souls of countless kin.
LanguageData.VV_Letter_EndingCalmGuide: Raids will stop for about {DAYS} days.
LanguageData.VV_Letter_EndingApocrypha: Dark energy is gathering above the everflower, forming a vast shape: Apocrypha, the Crumbled Queen. The last queen of the old empire lost her mind while trying to save her scaria-infected people and became the progenitor of all titanic hornets. Driven back by the everflower's waves, she is approaching the altar with a swarm of titanic hornets. \nBillions of bound fairy vivis surround her body. The everflower's bloom remains halted. The altar must be defended before she can claim the everflower.
LanguageData.VV_Letter_EndingCoronation: With Apocrypha gone, mana flows back into the altar and bloom condensation is complete. \nThe everflower awaits {PAWN_labelShort}'s coronation as queen. \nThe raids drawn by the everflower's mana waves have ended, and every titanic hornet vanished along with Apocrypha.
LanguageData.VV_Letter_EndingVictoryContinue: You can continue playing in this colony with the benefits of the level 6 everflower.
LanguageData.VV_EndingCredits:
{PAWN_nameDef} completes the coronation before the everflower on the altar. A crown of golden petals rises above {PAWN_possessive} head and fades.

The everflower opens into full bloom. A warm wave spreads across the land as petals drift through the air. Longer lives now await the vivis of the hive.

Centuries after the old empire fell, the great everflower has bloomed again. {PAWN_nameDef} has become queen of the vivis.
LanguageData.VV_EndingCreditsNoQueen: The everflower on the altar opens into full bloom. A warm wave spreads across the land as petals drift through the air. Longer lives now await the vivis of the hive.\n\nCenturies after the old empire fell, the great everflower has bloomed again.
LanguageData.VV_EndingCreditsExiled: The royal vivi once cast out for her small stature has built a hive to succeed the old empire.
LanguageData.VV_EndingCreditsRefugee: The refugees who lost everything to the titanic hornets now have the strength to defend their hive.
LanguageData.VV_EndingCreditsOutro: The spring of the old empire begins anew here. And your story continues...
LanguageData.VV_Letter_EndingFailureStolen: Apocrypha has drained all the everflower's power and vanished. \nOnly the altar remains, without its everflower. The final bloom has failed.
LanguageData.VV_Letter_EndingFailureLost: The everflower has been lost. Its condensed mana has scattered, and the final bloom has failed.
LanguageData.VV_Letter_EndingFailureResonator: {PAWN_labelShort} has fallen while in full assimilation, severing the resonance with the everflower. \nThe condensed mana has scattered, and the final bloom has failed.
LanguageData.VV_Message_EndingApocryphaLanded: Driven back by the everflower's wave, Apocrypha has landed at the edge of the map with a swarm of titanic hornets.
LanguageData.VV_Message_EndingPawnReturned: {PAWN_labelShort} has returned in front of the everflower altar.
LanguageData.VV_Message_EndingGrandAttunementNotStart: The grand attunement has ended, but the everflower could not begin its fifth bloom.
LanguageData.VV_Gizmo_EndingBloomDesc: The everflower is condensing mana for its final bloom.
LanguageData.VV_Gizmo_EndingBloomDescSiege: Enemies drawn by the everflower's mana waves are targeting the altar.
LanguageData.VV_Gizmo_EndingBloomDescCalm: Bloom condensation has stopped just before completion. Calm remaining: {TIME}
LanguageData.VV_Gizmo_EndingBloomDescBlocked: Apocrypha's interference has halted bloom condensation.
LanguageData.VV_Gizmo_EndingBloomDescCoronation: The queen's coronation is ready to begin.
LanguageData.VV_Inspector_EndingCalmDeferred: Apocrypha is searching for a way to the altar.
LanguageData.VV_DialogChangeWeatherGoldenBloomDesc: The power of the fully bloomed everflower blankets the area in golden mist and drifting petals. The mist lowers ranged accuracy, but while it lasts, every arcane plant has unlimited mana.
LanguageData.VV_FailReason_GoldenBloomHoldsWeather: The blooming everflower is sustaining the golden mist, preventing weather changes
